text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pathetic… I didn't even make it on the scoreboard. Everyone was so good, I didn't even stand a chance…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But still… I'm gonna take this pain, this frustration… and use it as fuel!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Haaah! I'll show everyone what I can really do!
choice_data_list: …Do you really think that's enough to win?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's review today's race right away! We've gotta strike while the iron is hot!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If we put our heads together, I just know I'll catch up to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …I know I'm still not good enough. But I do mean everything I say.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm going to use everything I've got to keep on charging forward!
